CVE-2026-104855.title: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. From 46.0.0 until 46.0.2 a ...
CVE-2026-104855.description: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. From 46.0.0 until 46.0.2 and 47.0.3, fuel and epoch preemption checks inside bulk operations including memory.copy, table.grow, and array.copy can expose invalid intermediate state when an embedder mutates a Store in Store::epoch_deadline_callback or continues using a Store after cancellation or a trap. A cancelled non-nullable table growth can leave null elements, linear-memory growth during memory.copy can invalidate retained raw pointers, and callback-triggered garbage collection during array.copy can invalidate GC pointers, resulting in a crash, invalid memory access, or GC heap corruption. Embeddings whose callbacks only access the host data in Store<T>, and embeddings that discard a Store after timeout or epoch deadline, are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 46.0.2 and 47.0.3.

CVE-2026-115382.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains a ...
CVE-2026-115382.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains a denial-of-service vulnerability in its wasi:http implementation that allows guests to panic the host. Guests can specify a zero between-bytes-timeout request option, which is forwarded directly to a Tokio API that panics, crashing the host embedding.

CVE-2026-115383.title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains a ...
CVE-2026-115383.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains an improper validation vulnerability that accepts components whose core modules import WebAssembly tags with a subtype of the original type. Malicious guests can mis-type exception object payloads to corrupt the GC heap, causing Wasmtime to panic when the exceptions proposal is enabled.

CVE-2026-115386.title: Wasmtime before 36.0.17, 37.0.0 before 48.0.4, and 49.0.0 before  ...
CVE-2026-115386.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.17, 37.0.0 before 48.0.4, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the WASIp1 fd_readdir implementation that copies uninitialized struct padding into guest memory. Guests with a preopened directory can list entries to receive three bytes of leftover host stack or heap memory per directory entry.

CVE-2026-115389.title: Wasmtime before 36.0.16, 37.0.0 before 48.0.3, and 49.0.0 before  ...
CVE-2026-115389.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.16, 37.0.0 before 48.0.3, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.1 does not adequately account for host allocations when lifting guest values through the dynamically-typed Val API, bypassing the hostcall fuel limit. A malicious WebAssembly guest can return crafted values that allocate at least ~100x more host memory than tracked, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-115390.title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.3 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.1 contains a ...
CVE-2026-115390.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.3 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.1 contains a fuel accounting flaw in Cranelift-compiled call_ref and try_table catch paths. Malicious guests can reset consumed fuel after calls to run exponentially long on linear fuel, evading timeouts and periodic yields for denial of service.

CVE-2026-115393.title: Wasmtime before 24.0.12, 25.0.0 before 36.0.13, 37.0.0 before 46. ...
CVE-2026-115393.description: Wasmtime before 24.0.12, 25.0.0 before 36.0.13, 37.0.0 before 46.0.2, and 47.0.0 before 47.0.3 contains a type confusion vulnerability because several Store APIs fail to validate that objects belong to the Store's Engine. Embedders mixing objects between Engines via Instance::new, StructRefPre::new, or Tag::new can trigger trampoline signature mismatches causing out-of-bounds stack writes, GC heap corruption, or panics.

CVE-2026-115892.title: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. From 46.0.0 until 48.0.7 a ...
CVE-2026-115892.description: Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. From 46.0.0 until 48.0.7 and 49.0.4, lowering a host-created component-model stream or future into a guest can omit a required payload-type check after the value passes through guest code and returns through StreamAny, FutureAny, Val::Stream, Val::Future, or an equivalent typed reader. A malicious guest that controls exported function types or returned values can cause the host to pass the type-erased value to a guest expecting a different payload type, which panics the Wasmtime host. This issue is fixed in versions 48.0.7 and 49.0.4.

CVE-2026-119132.title: Wasmtime from 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial-of-service v ...
CVE-2026-119132.description: Wasmtime from 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial-of-service vulnerability that allows a WebAssembly guest to trigger a host panic by transcoding overlapping strings in fused adapters. Attackers can make a same-instance component-to-component call transferring a string whose source and destination alias each other, crashing the host instead of raising a trap.

CVE-2026-119133.title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119133.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a memory misalignment flaw in VMContext layout that causes undefined behavior when modules contain an odd number of exception tags. A WebAssembly module with an odd tag count misaligns subsequent host fields in embedders with exceptions enabled, although no exploitation path is currently known.

CVE-2026-119134.title: Wasmtime before 36.0.18, 37.0.0 before 48.0.6, and 49.0.0 before  ...
CVE-2026-119134.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.18, 37.0.0 before 48.0.6, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 caps component-model resource handle tables only per component instance and does not charge handle allocations to any ResourceLimiter or StoreLimits. A malicious guest can repeatedly call resource.new and instantiate sub-components to exceed the per-instance cap many times over, causing unbounded host memory growth.

CVE-2026-119135.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 panics whe ...
CVE-2026-119135.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 panics when the host reads a component model stream as a different Rust item type than it was created with, because the host-to-host read path asserts matching TypeIds instead of returning an error. Guest code can return a host-created StreamReader<U> that the embedder reads as StreamReader<T>, where both types map to the same component model type, crashing the embedding process.

CVE-2026-119136.title: Wasmtime 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains i ...
CVE-2026-119136.description: Wasmtime 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains insufficient checks in Store when mixing async-style and sync-style WebAssembly calls. Embedders re-entering WebAssembly via sync APIs from host functions called asynchronously can trigger runtime panics or unsound cross-thread movement of !Send host variables.

CVE-2026-119137.title: Wasmtime 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119137.description: Wasmtime 42.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a stack overflow vulnerability that allows guests to crash the host through recursive type drops. Guests can define a long chain of recursive types so that removing the top-level type triggers unbounded recursive drops, exhausting the host stack.

CVE-2026-119138.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119138.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows pending calls to trigger an assertion failure after a trap poisons the Store. Attackers supplying misbehaving guest code can cause a trap and let earlier calls proceed, crashing embedders that continue using the inconsistent Store.

CVE-2026-119139.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119139.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a leftover assertion in component::Func::call that rejects guest exports using the async ABI option. An attacker who supplies a component with an async-lifted export can crash the host process when an embedder invokes that export through Func::call.

CVE-2026-119140.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119140.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows malicious components to panic the host via thread.yield in start functions. Attackers can supply a component whose start function calls an async-lowered import then thread.yield, causing an undisposed fiber drop that crashes embedders.

CVE-2026-119141.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119141.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows malicious Wasm modules to panic the host because the may_leave flag is not cleared during realloc. Attackers can call into the host from realloc while lowering stream or future results, such as cancelling the active read or re-waiting a waitable-set, crashing the host.

CVE-2026-119142.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119142.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability where dropping the Future returned by TypedFunc::call_async can panic the host. When the guest task has not started, cleanup code searches only one location for work items and unwraps the resulting error, crashing embedders that cancel pending calls.

CVE-2026-119143.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a ...
CVE-2026-119143.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows guest code to trigger a host panic through out-of-bounds zero-length stream operations. Malicious guests can perform zero-length component model stream reads or writes with unvalidated addresses, causing Direct{Source,Destination}::remaining to panic and crash WASIp3 embedders.

CVE-2026-121440.title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 fails to c ...
CVE-2026-121440.description: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 fails to check forwarded trailers against the WasiHttpHooks::is_forbidden_header hook in wasi-http p3. WASIp3 guests can forward a request or response body so its trailers skip embedder-customized forbidden header filtering, undermining header restrictions the embedder intended.

CVE-2026-121441.title: Wasmtime before 36.0.19, 37.0.0 before 48.0.7, and 49.0.0 before  ...
CVE-2026-121441.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.19, 37.0.0 before 48.0.7, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 contains a request smuggling vulnerability in wasi-http that allows guests to set multiple conflicting content-length headers. Malicious guests can make the host send HTTP requests with conflicting content-length values to smuggle requests through servers or intermediaries that do not reject them.

CVE-2026-64846.title: Nix is a package manager for Linux and other Unix systems. Prior  ...
CVE-2026-64846.description: Nix is a package manager for Linux and other Unix systems. Prior to 2.35.0, a malicious derivation executed with the recursive-nix experimental feature can exploit a time-of-check/time-of-use race involving final symlink handling in the LocalStore restore path. The race can cause writeFile to follow a substituted final symlink when opening a path with O_TRUNC instead of enforcing FinalSymlink::DontFollow, allowing the Nix process or nix-daemon to create or truncate an empty file outside the build sandbox with the daemon user's permissions. The primitive does not provide arbitrary-content writes and requires winning the race. This issue is fixed in version 2.35.0.
